description: This file implements the DelinquencyWritePlatformService for the Apache Fineract project, providing methods to create, update, delete delinquency ranges and buckets, calculate delinquency data, and apply delinquency tags to loans. It handles business logic related to loan delinquency management within the system.

classes.name: DelinquencyWritePlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the DelinquencyWritePlatformService interface, providing core functionality for managing delinquency ranges and buckets, computing delinquency data, and applying delinquency tags on loans within Apache Fineract.

methods.name: createDelinquencyRange
methods.description: Creates a new delinquency range based on validated input data.

methods.name: updateDelinquencyRange
methods.description: Updates an existing delinquency range identified by ID.

methods.name: deleteDelinquencyRange
methods.description: Deletes the specified delinquency range if no linked loan tags exist.

methods.name: createDelinquencyBucket
methods.description: Creates a new delinquency bucket and its associated range mappings.

methods.name: updateDelinquencyBucket
methods.description: Updates an existing delinquency bucket and its range mappings.

methods.name: deleteDelinquencyBucket
methods.description: Deletes a delinquency bucket if it has no linked products.

methods.name: calculateDelinquencyData
methods.description: Calculates delinquency data for a loan or loan schedule, returning delinquency date and days.

methods.name: applyDelinquencyTagToLoan
methods.description: Applies delinquency tags to a loan based on delinquency data, possibly affecting installments.

methods.name: applyDelinquencyToLoanAndInstallments
methods.description: Helper method applying delinquency tags to the loan and its installments.

methods.name: createDelinquencyAction
methods.description: Creates or updates a delinquency action record for a loan and triggers related business events.

methods.name: recalculateLoanDelinquencyData
methods.description: Recomputes delinquency data after a change in delinquency actions.

methods.name: removeDelinquencyTagToLoan
methods.description: Removes delinquency tags from a loan.

methods.name: cleanLoanInstallmentsDelinquencyTags
methods.description: Deletes all delinquency tags associated with loan installments.
